description: K₂Na(NH₂)₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/m space group. There are three inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to four equivalent N atoms. All K-N bond lengths are 2.91 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to four equivalent N and eight H atoms. All K-N bond lengths are 3.05 Å. There are four shorter (2.81 Å) and four longer (2.98 Å) K-H bond lengths. In the third K site, K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to four N and six H atoms. There are two shorter (2.88 Å) and two longer (2.90 Å) K-N bond lengths. There are a spread of K-H bond distances ranging from 2.77-2.89 Å. Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three N atoms. There are two shorter (2.34 Å) and one longer (2.40 Å) Na-N bond length. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and two equivalent H atoms. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to three K, one Na, and two H atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.03 Å) N-H bond length. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one K and one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two K and one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two K and one N atom.
